contradictions.source: ἵνα γένηται τῷ Πνεύματι ξένον, ὁ τῆς ἀηδοῦς θερμάτης κεκαθαρμένος.
contradictions.english: so that he who is purged of foul heat may be fervent in the Holy Spirit.
contradictions.why: The Greek says 'fervent in the Spirit' (or 'to the Spirit'), but the English adds 'Holy' which is not in the source text.
